verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official JavaScript plugin API described as 'fully supported between releases', plus sketchtool and a local MCP server. None of it documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, so the stability claim is adjacent rather than the capability itself. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and no evidence describes version identifiers, deprecation timelines or sunset notices.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
